Compute the objective for wls method

Source: R/estimate.R
obj_wls.Rd

Compute the objective for wls method

Usage

obj_wls(par, cor_fn, cor_emp, par_fixed)

Arguments

par

Parameters of cor_fn.

cor_fn

Correlation function.

cor_emp

Empirical correlations.

par_fixed

Fixed parameters of cor_fn.

Value

The objective of weighted least squares.
